# Introduction

The recent paper analyzing this data set is here: [Li, J., Simmons, A.J., Hawkins, C.V. et al. Identification and multimodal characterization of a specialized epithelial cell type associated with Crohn’s disease. Nat Commun 15, 7204 (2024). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-51580-7](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-024-51580-7)

More about dataset is here: [Bao S, Chiron S, Tang Y, et al. A cross-platform informatics system for the Gut Cell Atlas: integrating clinical, anatomical and histological data. Proc SPIE Int Soc Opt Eng. 2021](https://doi.org/10.1117/12.2581074)

Normalization (python):

``` 
# Calculate the mean intensity
mean_intensity = np.mean(img_array[img_array>0])
# Apply the normalization: log10(1 + raw_intensity / image_mean)
normalized_array = np.log10(1 + (img_array / mean_intensity))
```

```{r}
all.data <- lapply(markers, function(marker0){

    return(list_values)})
names(all.data) <- markers

# restructure the data into data frame
## list structure
## Categories (4)
##   -- Markers (14)
##       -- Individuals (38)
##           -- Values (synth/truth)
## columns: value, category (folders), marker, ID, truth/synth

convert_to_dataframe_tidy <- function(marker_data) {
  imap_dfr(marker_data, function(marker, marker_name) {
    imap_dfr(marker, function(id, id_name) {
      # Convert truth/synth to a list of tibbles
      map_dfr(id, function(vec) {
        tibble(
          value = unlist(vec),
          type = names(vec) %||% seq_along(vec),
          source = deparse(substitute(vec))  # Gets the name ('truth' or 'synth')
        )
      }, .id = "source") %>% 
        mutate(
          marker = marker_name,
          ID = id_name
        )
    })
  }) %>% 
    dplyr::select(value, type, marker, ID, source)
}

all.data.df <- convert_to_dataframe_tidy(all.data)



all.data.df$type <- factor(all.data.df$type, levels = c("", "90%", "95%", "99%"),
```

```{r}
# calculate truth
library(nlme)

res_truth_all <- list()
for(mkr in markers){
  truth_marker <- list()
  for (typ in c("mean", "q90", "q95", "q99")){
     subdata <- subset(all.data.df, type == typ & marker==mkr & source=="truth")
     subdata <- left_join(subdata, test.ID.df, by="ID")
     m0 <- lme(value ~ status, data=subdata , random = ~1|patient)
     coef_m0 <- m0$coefficients$fixed[2]
     sd_m0 <- sqrt(as.numeric(VarCorr(m0)[2,2]))
     truth_marker[[typ]] <- data.frame(coef = coef_m0, sd = sd_m0, type = typ, marker=mkr)
  }
  res_truth_all[[mkr]] <- truth_marker
}
# combine results
res_truth_all_list <- lapply(res_truth_all, function(listi){do.call(rbind, listi)})
res_truth_all_df <- do.call(rbind, res_truth_all_list)
```

# Analysis steps : multiple (stratified) imputation

With quantiles from 38 testing set tissues:

1. Combine normal with inactive, so now there are 13 active and 9 inactive
2. Bootstrap from 38 to 200
3. Split 200 tissues into calibration (100) and test (100)
4. Get empirical error from calibration: error = calibration truth - calibration synth
5. Sample empirical error (stratified) and add to test synth
6. rbind() calibration truth and test synth
7. Linear regression: quantiles ~ tumor status (inactive/active)
8. repeat 5-7 for 9 more times
9. use Rubin's rule for the multiple imputation results

```{r}
###################################
######### calculate truth #########
###################################
# read data
results_imp <- readRDS("/media/disk2/GCA_norm/sim_result_m50.rds")
results_strat <-  readRDS("/media/disk2/GCA_norm/sim_result_strat.rds")
## split data into calibration and testing
  # read calibration and testing split
  test.ID.df <- readRDS("~/ImImp/codeImputation/pixn2n/test.ID.df.rds")
  test.ID.df$status <- ifelse(test.ID.df$status=="normal", "inactive", test.ID.df$status)
  # use linear regression model
truth_list <- list()
markers <- c('CD11B', 'CD20', 'CD3D', 'CD4', 'CD45', 'CD68', 'CD8', 'CGA', 
             'ERBB2', 'FOXP3', 'LYSOZYME', 'OLFM4', 'PCNA', 'SOX9')
for(mkr in markers){  
  # read data
  data.marker <- readRDS(paste0("/media/disk2/GCA_norm/tissue_quantiles/", mkr, ".rds"))
  # extract: truth
  data_truth <- do.call(rbind, lapply(data.marker, "[[", "ref"))
  colnames(data_truth) <- c("mean", "q90", "q95", "q99")
  res_list <- list()
  for(type.i in colnames(data_truth)){
    ## calibration data frame and test data frame rbind()
    imputed_i_df <- data.frame(values = data_truth[,type.i],
                               test.ID.df[, c("status", "tissue.1", "patient")])
    # combine status
    imputed_i_df$status <- ifelse(imputed_i_df$status=="normal", "inactive", imputed_i_df$status)
    imputed_i_df$status <- factor(imputed_i_df$status, levels=c("inactive", "active"))
    m0 <- lm(values ~ status, imputed_i_df)
    coef_sd_m0 <- summary(m0)$coefficients[2,1:2]
    res_list[[type.i]] <- data.frame(mean = summary(m0)$coefficients[2,1], 
                               sd = summary(m0)$coefficients[2,2], stats=1.96, type = type.i, marker=mkr)
  }
  truth_list[[mkr]] <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
}
truth_df <- do.call(rbind, truth_list)
```

## Figure 1: bias

Bias of the estimator This plot is a point&bar plot, where:

1.  the point: the mean bias across all bootstrap simulations: $$
      \hat{Bias}(\theta_{syn})=\frac1B\sum(\hat\theta^b_{syn}-\theta)
      $$
2.  The standard deviation times 1.96 $$
      s = \frac{1}{B}\sqrt{\sum_{b=1}^B(\theta^b_{syn}-\frac{\sum\hat\theta^b_{syn}}B)^2}
      $$

```{r, fig.width=18}
# Combine results 
res.list.marker <- readRDS("/media/disk2/GCA_norm/sim_result_m50.rds")
truth_df <- readRDS("/media/disk2/GCA_norm/sim_truth.rds")
# extract mean into matrix: lapply this function to the 500 simulations
extract_mean <- function(listi){
  simi <- list()
  for(simType in 1:length(listi)){
    means.df <- do.call(rbind, listi[[simType]])
    means.df$marker <- rep(names(listi[[simType]]), each=4)
    simi[[simType]] <- means.df
  }
  simi.df <- do.call(rbind, simi)
  simi.df$simType <- rep(c("Truth", "Synthesis", "Complete", "MultSynth", "PAMS"), each=nrow(simi[[1]]))
  return(simi.df)
}
res.df.marker <- lapply(res.list.marker, extract_mean)
res.df.all <- do.call(rbind, res.df.marker)
```

## Figure 2: Accuracy of standard error estimation

This is fraction of

1.  Numerator $$
      \hat E(\hat{SE}(\hat\theta^b_{Imp}))=\frac1B\sum_{b=1}^B\hat{SE}(\hat\theta^b_{Imp})
      $$ where $\hat{SE}(\hat\theta^b_{Imp})$ is generated with the GEE parameter SE and rubin's rule.

2.  Denominator $$
      \hat{SE}(\hat\theta^b_{Imp})=\sqrt{\frac1{B-1}\sum_{b=1}^B(\hat\theta^b_{Imp}-\frac1B\sum{\hat\theta^b_{Imp}})^2}
      $$
      
```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
# calculate estimate and sd with dplyr

plot2.df <- res.df.all.imp %>% group_by(marker, type, simType) %>% 
  reframe(meanSD=mean(sd),SDmean=sd(mean),sd.ratio = mean(sd)/sd(mean))
plot2.df$simType <- factor(plot2.df$simType, levels = c("Complete", "Synthesis", "MultSynth", "PAMS"))
plot2_list <- list()
for(typei in types){
plot2_list[[typei]]<- ggplot(subset(plot2.df, type==typei))+
    geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(y=sd.ratio, x=simType), fill="#5D7A96", alpha=0.7, position=position_dodge(), width=0.8)+
    facet_wrap(~marker, scales = "free_y", ncol=7)+scale_y_continuous(labels=scaleFUN)+
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype="dashed", alpha=0.6, color="forestgreen")+
    theme_minimal()+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1, hjust=1))+ggtitle(paste0(typei))+
    labs(fill="Phenotype", x="Methods", y="Ratio of Standard Error")
}
ggarrange(plotlist = plot2_list,
          ncol = 1, nrow = 4)


```

## Figure 4: coverage

coverage

This is the percentage number of times that the confidence interval of the estimator catches the true estimator $\theta$, out of $B$ bootstrap simulations. The confidence interval standard deviation is generated with GEE parameter SEs and rubin's rule.

In each simulation, coverage is considered:
$$
     \hat\theta^b_{Imp}-sd*1.96<\theta<\hat\theta^b_{Imp}+sd*1.96
$$
assuming the t-stats is 1.96. It can be written as

$$
     -sd*1.96<\theta-\hat\theta^b_{Imp}<sd*1.96
$$
which is 

$$ |\theta-\hat\theta^b_{Imp}|<sd*1.96$$

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
names(res.df.all.imp)[1] <- "estimator"
plot4.df <- left_join(res.df.all.imp, truth_df[,c("mean","type", "marker")], by=c("type", "marker"))
coverage <- plot4.df %>%  
  reframe(coverage=stats*sd > abs(mean-estimator))
plot4.df <- data.frame(plot4.df, coverage)
plot4.df <- plot4.df  %>% group_by(marker, type, simType) %>% 
  reframe(cov.mean=mean(coverage))
plot4.df$simType <- factor(plot4.df$simType, levels = c("Complete", "Synthesis", "MultSynth", "PAMS"))
plot4_list <- list()
for(typei in types){
plot4_list[[typei]]<- ggplot(subset(plot4.df, type==typei))+
    geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(y=cov.mean, x=simType), fill="#5D7A96", alpha=0.7, position=position_dodge(), width=0.8)+
    facet_wrap(~marker, scales = "free_y", ncol=7)+scale_y_continuous(labels=scaleFUN)+
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = "95% CI Target"), 
               color = "forestgreen") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("95% CI Target" = "dashed"), name = NULL) +
    theme_minimal()+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 0.8))+ggtitle(paste0(typei))+
    labs(x="Methods", y="Coverage")
}
ggarrange(plot4_list[[1]],
          plot4_list[[2]],
          plot4_list[[3]],
          plot4_list[[4]], 
          ncol = 1, nrow = 4)
```

```{r fig.height=20, fig.width=10}
# essentially summary data comparison
test.ID.df$status <- ifelse(test.ID.df$status=="normal", "inactive", test.ID.df$status)
status.df <- test.ID.df[, c("ID", "status")]
fig1.df <- left_join(all.data.df, status.df, by="ID")

# t.test

# Create a combined grouping variable for all combinations of group1 and group2
df <- fig1.df  %>%
  mutate(combined_group = interaction(type, marker, status, sep = ": "))

# Function to perform t-test and extract p-value
get_p_value <- function(data) {
  if (n_distinct(data$symption) < 2) {
    return(NA) # Cannot perform t-test if only one level of symption
  }
  tryCatch({
    t.test_result <- t.test(value ~ status, data = data)
    return(t.test_result$p.value)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NA) # Return NA if t-test fails
  })
}

# Group by the combined group and apply the t-test function
p_values <- fig1.df %>%
  group_by(type, marker, source) %>%
  summarise(pval = t.test(value ~ status)$p.value)
p_values$y <- case_when(
    p_values$type == "mean" ~ 0.3,
    p_values$type == "q90" ~ 0.6,
    p_values$type == "q95" ~ 0.75,
    p_values$type == "q99" ~ 1.2
)
p_values$pval <- ifelse(p_values$pval>0.001, as.character(round(p_values$pval, 4)), "<0.001")
p_values <- data.frame(p_values)

fig.list <- list()
for(typei in c("mean", "q90", "q95", "q99")){
  fig1.sub <- subset(fig1.df, type==typei)
  pval.sub <- subset(p_values, type==typei)
  p <- 
  ggplot() +
  geom_violin(data = fig1.sub, aes(x=source, y=value, fill=status), alpha=0.2, color="grey40") +
  geom_jitter(data = fig1.sub, aes(x=source, y=value, fill=status, color=status), size=1, alpha=1, stroke = 0,
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3, dodge.width = 1)) +
  geom_text(data = pval.sub ,aes(x=source, y = y, label = pval),  color="red") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("active" = "red", "inactive" = "blue")) + # Set contrasting colors
  theme(
    legend.position="right",# Changed to show the legend for points
    plot.title = element_text(size = 5), # Adjust title size
    legend.text = element_text(size = 4),  # Adjust legend text size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 5)   # Adjust legend title size (if any)
  ) +
  theme_pubclean() +
  ggtitle(paste0("compare truth and synth: slide ", typei)) +
  facet_wrap(~marker, nrow=2) +
  xlab("")
  fig.list[[typei]] <- p
}

ggarrange(fig.list[[1]],
          fig.list[[2]],
          fig.list[[3]],
          fig.list[[4]],
          ncol = 1, nrow = 4)
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
calib_data_synth <- do.call(rbind, lapply(calib_data_list, "[[", "input"))
# extract: synth, calibration
test_data_synth <- do.call(rbind, lapply(test_data_list, "[[", "input"))

plot(x=test_data_truth[,4], y=test_data_synth[,4], ylab="synth_q99", xlab="truth_q99", main="Incomplete in one simulation")
 abline(a=0, b=1)
 
# make plot figure data frame

boxplot(synth ~ status ,data=diag.plot.df, main="Incomplete Synth \n (mean) in one simulation")

empirical_error <- calib_data_truth - calib_data_synth

# multiple imputation (simple)
imputed_list <- imputed_list_robust <- list()
  sample_idx <- sample(1:nrow(empirical_error), nrow(test_data_synth), replace = TRUE)
  error_sampled <- empirical_error[sample_idx,]
  imputed <- data.frame(test_data_synth + error_sampled)
boxplot(imputed[,4] ~ test.ID.df$status[test.patient], main="Incomplete Synth (simple) in \n one simulation & imputation", 
        ylab="synth_multi_simple", xlab="status")

diag.plot.df$status <- factor(diag.plot.df$status, levels=c("inactive", "active"))
m0_true <- lm(truth ~ status, diag.plot.df)
estimate_true <- m0_true$coefficients[2]
stdError_true <- sqrt(vcovHC(m0_true, type = "HC3")[2,2])

m0_synth <- lm(synth ~ status, diag.plot.df)
estimate_synth <- m0_synth$coefficients[2]
stdError_synth <- sqrt(vcovHC(m0_synth, type = "HC3")[2,2])

diag.plot.df$multi <- imputed[,4]

estimate_multi <- m0_multi$coefficients[2]
stdError_multi <- sqrt(vcovHC(m0_multi, type = "HC3")[2,2])

imputed_list <- imputed_list_robust <- list()
  for (i in 1:10){
      sample_idx <- sample(1:nrow(empirical_error), nrow(test_data_synth), replace = TRUE)
      
    error_sampled <- empirical_error[sample_idx,]
    imputed <- data.frame(test_data_synth + error_sampled)
    names(imputed) <- colnames(calib_data_truth)
    
    # use linear regression model
    res_list <- list()
    type.i=4
      ## calibration data frame and test data frame rbind()
      imputed_i_df <- data.frame(values = imputed[[type.i]],
                                 test.ID.df[test.patient, c("status", "tissue.1", "patient")])
      
      # combine status
      imputed_i_df$status <- ifelse(imputed_i_df$status=="normal", "inactive", imputed_i_df$status)
      imputed_i_df$status <- factor(imputed_i_df$status, levels=c("inactive", "active"))
      
        m0 <- lm(values ~ status, imputed_i_df)
        estimate <- m0$coefficients[2]
        stdError <- sqrt(vcovHC(m0, type = "HC3")[2,2])
        res_list <- list(coef = estimate, sd = stdError, type = type.i)
            imputed_list[[i]] <- res_list
    }

  
  ## Rubin's rule
  # extract patient outcome
imputed_i_res_df <- data.frame(lapply(names(imputed_list[[1]]),
                                    function(nm){unlist(lapply(imputed_list, "[[", nm))}))
names(imputed_i_res_df) <- names(imputed_list[[1]])
type_output <- rubin_imp_calc(imputed_i_res_df)

                          error = c(stdError_true, stdError_synth, type_output$sd),
                          type=c("Truth", "Synth", "Bootstrap(Rubin)"))

                                error = imputed_i_res_df$sd,
                                type=paste0("Simple", 1:10))
                                )
```
